# ACOMP-19 — Simplify Analog Compressor control layout and ratios

**Tracking issue:** https://github.com/tonygward/audio-plugins/issues/298
**Origin:** Generated by Matrix from the tracking issue when the card was picked up, because no prompt file existed and the issue had enough detail. The issue text below is the specification.

## Objective and user value
Simplify the Songsmith Analog Compressor's main editor as approved in the 15 Nov 2026 Studio One screenshot. Group the detector control near the input, move secondary processing options to the right, remove the now-unnecessary gentle ratio, and remove redundant explanatory text. Keep the 1176-inspired workflow uncluttered now that **Songsmith Compressor** (#235) handles clean/gentle compression.

## Existing → desired
1. **Ignore Below:** relocate the *existing horizontal 20–500 Hz slider* from the lower-right under the meter to **beneath the Input knob** on the left. Maintain Off and continuous values, editable/readable frequency, precise adjustment, host automation and detector-only filtering. Preserve ACOMP-16 (#237) functionality; this is position only.
2. **Oversampling:** move the *existing* control from the bottom-left to the **right-hand side** of the editor, in the lower-right controls region, below/near the gain-reduction meter without overlap. Do not duplicate it, alter audio settings or place it in the common title bar. **This supersedes the far-left placement specified by ACOMP-15 (#236).**
3. **Ratio:** remove **2:1** from the visible Analog Compressor ratio options. Retain 4:1, 8:1, 12:1, 20:1 and All; retain 4:1 default. Songsmith Compressor is the home for gentle compression. **Compatibility is essential:** do not delete/reindex an existing parameter or silently change old saved 2:1 presets, DAW projects, host automation or DSP. Prefer retaining its legacy internal value and mapping/displaying it safely while hiding it from *new* UI choices; document what users see if a legacy instance loads with 2:1 (e.g. explicit legacy indication, without a misleading highlighted 4:1). Review ACOMP-11 (#199), ACOMP-10 (#265) model-specific AE reference.
4. **All Buttons:** remove the persistent **yellow 'all radio buttons on' explanatory note** (where currently rendered). The All control is sufficient. Preserve the All button/mode and its processing, plus concise accessibility tooltip if useful. Do not remove the yellow/amber *selected-ratio highlighting* elsewhere unless it is solely the redundant note.

## Layout guidance
- Keep Input, Output, Attack, Release, ratio stack and gain-reduction VU/meter substantially in their current regions.
- Place Ignore Below directly under Input with aligned width/spacing.
- Place Oversampling on the right in available lower space, respecting the gain-reduction and output meter selections.
- Confirm no collisions, truncated labels or unreachable controls in smallest/default/max sizes and DPI scaling. Screenshot reference: user-provided Studio One view (v0.5.34).

## Acceptance criteria
- Correct locations and control visibility on Windows VST3 and macOS, across supported editor sizes.
- No 2:1 *selection* on new instances; no accidental change to historical project/preset/automation ratios, parameter identifiers or parameter order. Test legacy 2:1 recall explicitly.
- Ignore Below remains Off/20–500 Hz continuous, preserving audio behaviour; Oversampling retains all states and sound/latency.
- All mode remains available; the persistent explanatory annotation is gone.
- Presets, undo/redo, bypass, meter operation and saved state survive layout changes.

## Tests
Automated UI geometry/visibility tests; parameter and preset serialization and legacy session tests (especially 2:1); detector-filter range/state tests; oversampling state/latency tests; All Buttons DSP regression; native Windows/macOS builds, DAW screenshots/visual checks.

## Dependencies and risks
Related: ACOMP-15 #236 (old left-side placement, superseded), ACOMP-16 #237 (slider preserved), ACOMP-11 #199 (2:1 introduced), ACOMP-14 #234 (ratio tooltip behaviour), COMP-01 #235 (clean compressor). **Priority risk:** host automation and backward compatibility when removing a ratio choice. If the yellow wording is already absent in the current branch, treat that subtask as already satisfied and verify.

## Build / release
Use normal Matrix/Claude Code workflow, Sonnet by default; retain a canonical prompt file linked from the issue during implementation. Run tests and CI, trusted merge, increment patch/build per current repo policy, publish suite installers to private R2 and update beta site. Comment with evidence before closing and moving board to Done. **Creating this issue is backlog only, not Matrix pickup.**
